content: Mbandu ya Bulahami
Biki twazímbula si kikuma kya khaka wetu mu musuni Bulahami? Biki kátambula mu kimutu kyandi?
Kikuma yuka ni Bulahami kámonika mutu wamasonga ku thwala ya Nzambi kikuma kya mihangu myandi mina káhanga, wadi kakhana ditsikisa. Kaasi káhangabwoku ku thwala ya Nzambi.
Kikuma, Masonuku mazimbudini: «Bulahami wákwikila mwena Nzambi, amana Nzambi wámutambwasa hanga mutu wa masonga mu kutala lukwikilu lwandi.»
Kinga kwena musadi, lufutu lwisiku monika hanga kabu, kaasi lufutu lwa phila ya kisalu kyandi.
Kwena mutu wuna kondi sala kisalu, kaasi kisi kwikila mwena Nzambi wuna wisi kitula batu bambi bakala batu ba masonga basumuki, kikuma kya lukwikilu lwandi Nzambi kamútanga hanga mutu wa masonga.
Bwosu kisi zimbula Tavidi ni mukwa kyesi kenina mutu wuna kisi tala Nzambi hanga mukwa masonga konda kumutangila mihangu:

content.text: Kyesi kwena mutu wuna Pfumu katangidiku keti disumu dyandi

content: Musamu wawu wa kyesi wenina kikuma kya batu baba bákota mukhanda ho kikuma kya bangulungu phi? Kikuma thwisi zimbula: «Kwena Bulahami, lukwikilu lwandi lwámutangisa hanga mutu wa masonga».
Khi phila kákala tangwa bámutanga? Hana wukoti kedi mukhanda ho ngulungu kákala? Hana khaku kedi kakota mukhanda, ngulungu kákala.

Bulahami kisa kota mukhanda mu kitulu hanga kidimbu: kinyeminu kya masonga mana kátambula mu lukwikilu tangwa kákala ngulungu. Bwabuna kákitukila tata wa batu boosu babana bisi kwikila, mbatanana benina ngulungu, ndangu babatangila bawu phi hanga bakwa masonga.
Kenina phi tata wa batu babana bákota mukhanda, heku ni babana lwesi bákota mukhanda, kaasi babana bisi landa mbandu ya lukwikilu luna kákala lwawu tata wetu Bulahami, tangwa kákala ngulungu.
Kilangi kya Nzambi twátambula mu nzila ya lukwikilu
Kikuma, heku ni mu nzila ya mitsiku, Nzambi kámuhekila Bulahami kilangi kya kukala swana wa tsi holo kwena batekulu bandi, kaasi mu nzila ya masonga muna lukwikilu.
Mukuma wadi ni baswana bakalaka batu babana bisi lemvuka ku mitsiku, wadi lukwikilu lukhaniku kala mupfunu amana kilangi kya Nzambi bazónzilakyoku hika.
Kikuma mitsiku, khabu myisi lumbula; amana hana hakondi mitsiku, heku phi kukulula kwa mitsiku.

Yihana ni, kilangi kina kyisila mu nzila ya lukwikilu, ndangu dyakala kabu dya khenda ya Nzambi amana dyakala phi kabu dina básila mbundu kwena batekulu boosu, heku ni kwena babana lwesi bisi zitisa mitsiku kaasi yi kwena babana phi benina yi lukwikilu hanga luna lwa Bulahami. Yandi wuna wenina tata wa betu boosu,

bwosu menina Masonuku: «Yíkuswanika ngeyi tata wa lawu dya makanda.» Yandi wenina ku thwala ya Nzambi wuna kákwikila, Nzambi wuna wisi hana luzingu kwena batu bafwa yi wuna wisi tela mu luzingu bima bina bisiku zinga.
Mbatanana tangwa dyáhita mu kusila kivuvu, Bulahami wásya kivuvu, amana wákwikila. Yihana kákitukila «tata wa lawu dya makanda», bwosu bámuzimbwala: «Bwabuna dyákala butuka dyaku
Mbatanana kákala yi kitesu kya mvula khama mosi, kaasi kálembwaku mu lukwikilu lwandi tangwa kakala tala lutu lwandi lulembwi kedi, yi mukhetu wandi Sala yandu wáfwanaku hika mu kubuta
Kinga mu kutala kilangi kya Nzambi káketyanisaku kivuvu kyandi mu kukonda kwa lukwikilu; kaasi lukwikilu lwandi lwámuyika kikesa amana wámukembisa Nzambi.
Kákala yi kikumbwala kya lawu ni Nzambi kenina yi hamu dya kulungisa mana kásila.
Kikuma kya bwabuna phi, muna lukwikilu lwandi, Nzambi kámutangila «Mutu wa masonga».
Kaasi heku ni kikuma kya yandi lwesi bwásonamina: «Mamana mátangama kikuma kya yandi».
Kikuma kya betu phi babana bátangilabwa kilumbu, betu baba thwisi kwikila mwena yandu wáfutumuna ha kati dya bafwa, Yesu, Pfumu wetu.
Yandi wuna bálambula kikuma kya mitsoki metu amana káfutumuka ndangu katukitula batu ba masonga.
